sourceFindings.finding: Outcome IDs are preserved by array position, so reordering unchanged lines can change the wording associated with evidence-linked IDs.
sourceFindings.proposedControl: Preserve IDs by normalised wording, same-position fallback for deliberate edits, reject duplicates and block removal of linked IDs.

sourceFindings.finding: Deleting a unit with linked evidence leaves the evidence stored but removes its unit context.
sourceFindings.proposedControl: Block deletion while linked evidence exists.

sourceFindings.finding: Each app maintains an independent name list without a shared stable learner ID.
sourceFindings.proposedControl: Versioned shared roster with stable IDs and explicit adapters.

sourceFindings.finding: Rubric marks and feedback cannot be queued as a structured review draft in the evidence workflow.
sourceFindings.proposedControl: Assessment-decision hand-off with not-assessed default and staff review.

sourceFindings.finding: Manual claims of 28 and 23 tools do not match the 30-entry catalogue.
sourceFindings.proposedControl: Remove manual counts from prose and derive display totals from apps.json.

sourceFindings.finding: The checker searches index.html for retired inline f:"..." records after the catalogue moved to apps.json.
sourceFindings.proposedControl: Read apps.json directly and fail an empty catalogue.
